Quick answers about CloudTalk
QWho invested in CloudTalk?
CloudTalk's investors include Point Nine Capital and Presto Ventures.
QHow much has CloudTalk raised?
CloudTalk has raised $39M across 4 rounds since 2009.
QWhen did CloudTalk last raise?
CloudTalk's most recent round was a Series B of $28M in Jan 2024.
QWhat was CloudTalk's biggest round?
Its most recent round, $28M in Jan 2024, is also its largest on record.
QWho backed CloudTalk first?
CloudTalk's first round on record, in Jan 2024, was backed by Point Nine Capital and Presto Ventures.
QWhat stage is CloudTalk at?
CloudTalk's latest named round is a Series B, in Jan 2024.
QWhere is CloudTalk based?
CloudTalk is based in the United States.
